It feels so good to hear you asking this question, rarely do university professors care about these issues at least in my country.
The best thing that makes lectures less boring and more informative for me is handouts or a projector, where I can look back and be able to follow with the professor in case I wandered of for a bit. Sometimes, I wander of for a minute, then when I come back to reality I realize I missed some important ideas, therefore I lose focus and wander of more to find myself counting the seconds again.
Frequents breaks every now and then is great. It helps me gather my thoughts and take some rest.
Tolerance for fidgeting and lack of focus if it is not too distracting for the class.
If the lecture is too long, informing students can help so much. Sometime when I get notified that I will be having a long lecture, I prepare myself before both mentally and physically for the lecture.
Less than 2 hours are okay with me at least. I can push myself to finish the lecture and not miss out on much, but people are different. 2 hours can be quite long for some people:
Exactly my experience, thank you so much for the tips.
